toolCalls.commandLine: const r = await tools.shell_command({command:"$launcher=Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList @('scripts/run.mjs','dev','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','4182') -WorkingDirectory $PWD.Path -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru; $listener=$null; try { for($i=0;$i -lt 60;$i++){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300; $listener=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4182 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if($listener){break}}; if(-not $listener){throw 'npm run dev did not open port 4182'}; $res=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10 'http://127.0.0.1:4182/'; \"DEV_STATUS=$($res.StatusCode) LISTENER_PID=$($listener.OwningProcess) LAUNCHER_PID=$($launcher.Id)\" } finally { if($listener){$proc=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId=$($listener.OwningProcess)\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($proc -and $proc.CommandLine -like '*vite*'){Stop-Process -Id $listener.OwningProcess -Force}}; if(-not $launcher.HasExited){Stop-Process -Id $launcher.Id -Force} }","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura-benchmark\\raw\\rewrite-codex-cli-0.144.1-high-20260714-191730\\project-rebuild-makeup-tanstack-fullstack\\prompt-gallery-tanstack-fullstack-rebuild-codex-cli-r02\\projects\\makeup-codex-cli","timeout_ms":30000}); text(r);
